recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only the top of the dome above the copper band: it becomes a cap of bright polished copper, colour #d86a2a, with darker copper #9a4416 shading and a pale #f2b27a shine, so the tank is copper on top and soot-black iron below. Keep the soot-black iron lower dome with its rivets, the copper band, the wheels, the cannon snout, the smokestack and its white steam, the dwarf in the hatch, the shapes, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: Lineup study: steam-tank-a measures 10.7 from the Goblin Scrap Buggy in palette distance (6.2 for a deuteranope), closer than nine in ten pairs of the accepted factions; does a copper cap move it away?

recipes.editInstruction: Add only one thing: one small round bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a with a white #e8ffe8 glint, about three pixels wide, set in a little copper ring on the front of the iron dome below the hatch. Do not change anything else: keep the soot-black iron dome, the copper band, the wheels, the cannon snout, the smokestack and its white steam, the dwarf in the hatch, the shapes, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: Lineup study: the reserve signal-green gauge lamp of the spec (16.4) on the Steam Tank, the pair that fails the colour measure.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only one thing: erase the two small white puffs sticking up from the top of the helmet, so the round soot-black iron helmet has a smooth round top with nothing on it; do not redraw anything else. Keep the goggles, the ginger beard, the face, the armour, the hammer, the shapes, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: hammerer-a is the right dwarf, but two white steam puffs on the helmet read as white horns or feathers (the Orc Warboss has a horned helmet).

recipes.editInstruction: Change only one thing: erase the two thin landing skids and their struts under the gyrocopter, leaving empty transparent background there, so it flies with nothing under it except the round black bomb hanging from the seat; do not redraw anything else. Keep the rotor, the dwarf pilot, the iron pod, the copper engine and its steam, the tail, the shapes, thick black outline and art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: gyrocopter-a is the right open rotor craft; removing its skids leaves the flyer's gap under it, as the Martian Saucer's legs were removed.

recipes.editInstruction: Add only one thing: one small round bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a with a white #e8ffe8 glint, about three pixels wide, set in a little copper ring on the side of the iron carriage. recipes.editInstruction: Add only one tiny detail: one small round bright signal-green lamp dot, colour #2bd94a, about three pixels wide, on the round copper boiler behind the barrel, just below the smokestack. recipes.notes: steam-cannon-a-lamp put the lamp in the muzzle, like a glowing barrel, and dropped a loose copper ring on the ground; name the boiler as the place.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only the carriage and wheels: the orange-brown carriage becomes soot-black riveted iron plates #3a3835 with a light warm grey #8a8580 top edge, and the wheels become soot-black iron wheels with copper hubs, so nothing looks like wood. Keep the black barrel, the copper boiler with its green lamp and steam, the two dwarf gunners, the shapes, black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.

recipes.editInstruction: Add only one tiny detail: one small round bright signal-green lamp dot, colour #2bd94a, about three pixels wide, on the side of the soot-black iron pod below the pilot.
